pages.title: Solar Power
pages.text: The Photovoltaic Generator turns sunlight straight into $(thing)direct current$() and buffers up to $(thing)3 000 EP$() inside. It is the only generator that needs no fuel at all; the price is that it only works during the day.$(br2)Its first slot accepts a $(l:moderndelight:power_sys/battery)battery$() and charges it at $(thing)80 EP$() per second.

pages.title: Output
pages.text: The generator settles once per second; output depends on $(thing)time of day$(), $(thing)weather$() and $(thing)height$():$(br)$(li)Dawn and dusk ×1$(li)Morning and afternoon ×2$(li)Noon (tick 4283~7700) ×3$(br2)The higher the better: at Y=64 on a clear noon it makes about $(thing)96 EP/s$(), and at Y=200 about $(thing)300 EP/s$().$(br2)Rain cuts the output a little, thunderstorms cut it a lot; even at noon, rain never shuts it down.

pages.title: Two Working Modes
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)High-efficiency mode$(): the sky light at its position is 13 or more, there is no full solid block directly above, and the dimension is not one without a day-night cycle, such as the Nether or the End. Only then does it generate according to the time of day.$(li)$(bold)Low-efficiency mode$(): triggered by enough $(thing)block light$() around it (torches, lanterns and so on). Each extra point of block light is worth only about $(thing)1 EP/s$() — better than nothing.$(br2)Note that the two modes do not conflict: in the open during the day, both are settled together.

pages.title: How to Use It
pages.text: The photovoltaic generator $(thing)outputs from its back$() — that is, the side opposite its facing — up to 1 000 EP per second. To hook up a consumer, point the back at whatever should receive the power.$(br2)It produces only direct current, so it can charge batteries directly or supply a $(l:moderndelight:power_sys/charging_post)Charging Post$(); to feed AC machines it must go through an $(l:moderndelight:power_sys/ac_and_dc)AC/DC Converter$().$(br2)The Nether and the End have no day-night cycle, so solar panels there generate $(thing)nothing at all$().
